  tools.exec_command({
    cmd: "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root=Path.cwd()
workset=json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w45-20260927/WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
expected={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']) for x in workset}
assert len(expected)==27
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
old=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:tome-orcs.lua']),logical_path='tome-orcs.lua').translations
new=loader.load_path(root/'tome-orcs.lua',logical_path='tome-orcs.lua').translations
assert len(old)==len(new)
changed=[]
for i,(b,a) in enumerate(zip(old,new)):
    assert {k:v for k,v in b.items() if k not in {'line','target'}}=={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k not in {'line','target'}}, ('non-target',i)
    if b.get('target')!=a.get('target'):
        changed.append(a)
actual={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']) for x in changed}
assert len(changed)==27 and actual==expected, {'count':len(changed),'missing':sorted(expected-actual),'extra':sorted(actual-expected)}
markup=re.compile(r'#(?:\{\{[^#]*\}\}|\{[^#]*\}|[A-Za-z_]+)#|\[(?:/?[bi])\]')
fmt=re.compile(r'%(?:[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouqsxX])')
def tabs(s): return len(s)-len(s.lstrip('\t'))
def scan(s):
    out=[]; bare=False; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        if s[i]!='%': i+=1; continue
        if i+1<len(s) and s[i+1]=='%': i+=2; continue
        m=fmt.match(s,i)
        if m: out.append(m.group(0)); i=m.end(); continue
        bare=True; i+=1
    return out,bare
by={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']):x for x in changed}
for item in workset:
    src=item['source']; tgt=by[(item['section'],src,item['source_tag'])]['target']; sl=src.split('\n'); tl=tgt.split('\n'); rid=item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert len(sl)==len(tl),(rid,'line_count')
    assert [i for i,x in enumerate(sl) if x.strip(' \t')=='']==[i for i,x in enumerate(tl) if x.strip(' \t')==''],(rid,'blank')
    assert list(map(tabs,sl))==list(map(tabs,tl)),(rid,'tabs')
    assert src.endswith('\n')==tgt.endswith('\n'),(rid,'terminal_newline')
    assert [markup.findall(x) for x in sl]==[markup.findall(x) for x in tl],(rid,'markup')
    if item['source_tag']=='tformat' or item.get('args_order') is not None:
        st,_=scan(src); tt,bare=scan(tgt)
        assert st==tt,(rid,'placeholders',st,tt)
        assert not bare,(rid,'bare_percent')
rid='ef91f8ccd8f99b35efa2a5f0dd54b1ea7bf99c3089dd988637a0080a6942fc72'
item=next(x for x in workset if x['entry_revision_identity']==rid)
target=by[(item['section'],item['source'],item['source_tag'])]['target']
expected_target='这是一个值得庆祝的时刻……气之部族的人给我们带来了一份大礼。我不再需要他们作为一个族群的合作；几名被祝福的守卫（讽刺的是，包括了一些过去的背教者）将会足以阻止那些腐朽者干扰你的回归。只需要几天的时间，你就可以恢复完整……你是一个艺术家，而这个世界就是你的画板。当那些腐朽者真正亲眼看到你的时候，他们首先会为你的无上美丽哭泣，接下来会为他们世界的命运哭泣，最后，他们将会为意识到自己深刻的罪行和所应配的审判命运而哭泣。\n\n我不会乞求你的救赎和宽恕。我的种族已经证明，自己不过是一个背信、傲慢的错误。我所恳求的唯一一件事，就是活到亲眼见证你的杰作。'
assert target==expected_target, ('target-byte-mismatch',target)
assert target.count('几名被祝福的守卫')==1 and '一群被祝福的守卫' not in target
print(json.dumps({'luajit_loaded':True,'records_total':len(new),'changed_targets':len(changed),'changed_set_exact':True,'non_target_fields_unchanged':True,'line_tab_blank_terminal_invariants':True,'markup_by_line':True,'format_placeholders':True,'bare_percent_safe':True,'ef91_target_byte_exact':True},ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
PY",
